captions.detailed: A workshop-scale bicycle track pump featuring a tall, silver-grey steel barrel mounted on a wide, black footplate base. At the top, a broad black T-handle with textured grips is connected to a polished metallic piston rod that extends into the barrel. Near the base, a circular pressure gauge with a white dial face, black tick marks, and a rotating red needle is mounted, accompanied by a small, separate red pressure-release button. A black flexible hose loops up from the base and is parked against the side of the barrel via two small black clips. The T-handle and its piston rod translate prismatically along the vertical axis, the gauge needle rotates around its center, and the red release button operates as a prismatic push-button.
captions.instruction: Generate a parametric 3D model of a bicycle track pump with a vertical silver barrel, a wide black footplate, and a top T-handle connected to a metallic piston rod. Include a circular pressure gauge at the base with a white face and a red needle, a separate red release button, and a black hose clipped to the side. Ensure the handle translates prismatically, the needle rotates, and the release button has a prismatic push motion.
captions.factory: Construct the base using a flat rectangular Box with a raised central collar. Model the barrel as a tall, hollow Cylinder with a silver material finish. Build the handle assembly using a vertical piston cylinder joined to a horizontal cylinder for the T-bar, with cylindrical handgrips on each end. Create the gauge housing using a shallow cylinder, adding a thin white disc for the face, a small red wedge for the needle, and a small red cylinder for the release button. Define prismatic joints for the handle along the Z-axis and the release button, and a revolute joint for the gauge needle.
